ILOE categories

Example: average basic salary AED 12,000 (Category A). 60% = AED 7,200 a month, below the AED 10,000 cap. Up to AED 21,600 over three months, for a premium of AED 60 a year.

Losing your job also triggers your gratuity, unused leave and notice pay — add them up in the final settlement calculator. Prefer Arabic? Use the Arabic version.

Frequently asked questions

Who can claim ILOE compensation?

You must have been subscribed continuously for at least 12 months before losing your job, the termination must not be for disciplinary reasons or by resignation, you must claim within 30 days of leaving work, and you must not be working for another employer when you claim.

How long is compensation paid?

Up to three months per claim, or until you find a new job, whichever comes first.

What is the fine for not subscribing?

AED 400 for not subscribing within the deadline after the work permit is issued, and AED 200 for being more than three months late with premiums. The policy may also be cancelled, restarting the subscription period.

Does ILOE cover resignation?

No. It covers involuntary job loss only. Resignation, disciplinary dismissal and termination by mutual agreement are not covered.

Is the payout based on basic or gross salary?

On your average basic salary over the six months before you lost your job, not on gross salary.
